image_description: A Roseate Spoonbill standing in shallow, rippling water. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its wings and body, a white neck with a yellowish patch near the shoulder, and a long, dark, spatulate bill. Its legs are partially submerged but appear dark and slender. The background consists of golden-hued water reflections.
